:::{#sol-matrix-mult-practice}

$\matr{A}$ has three [column](#def-matrix-column)s and $\matr{B}$ has three [row](#def-matrix-row)s,
so the [product](#def-matrix-mult) is defined and is $2 \times 2$.
Its entries are

$$
\ba
\matr{A}\matr{B}
&= \begin{bmatrix}
1 \cd 2 + 0 \cd 0 + 2 \cd 1 & 1 \cd 1 + 0 \cd (-1) + 2 \cd 4 \\
(-1) \cd 2 + 3 \cd 0 + 1 \cd 1 & (-1) \cd 1 + 3 \cd (-1) + 1 \cd 4
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-mult)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 9 \\ -1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.
&& \text{(multiply and add)}
\ea
$$

:::
